## Prime-Agent System Prompt (ACP Template)

For file editing operations, the prime-agent runtime exposes a pre-installed `mcp` Python object with `list_tools` and `call_tool` methods. Use them to discover and invoke tools.

Example discovery and call:

```python
tools_list = await mcp.list_tools("tools")
for t in tools_list:
    print(t["name"], t["inputSchema"])

result = await mcp.call_tool("tools", "ox-bridge-write", {"path": "/tmp/x.py", "content": "# code here"})
print(result)
```

The `tools` MCP server exposes:
- `ox-bridge-write`: write a file (args: `path`, `content`)
- `ox-bridge-edit`: edit a file with hunks (args: `path`, `edits` = [{old, new}])
- `ox-bridge-read`: read a file region (args: `path`, `start`, `end`)

All bridging calls return synchronously. Print results to confirm before proceeding.

Tag-input chip component in React. /workspace/tags: TagInput.tsx controlled by value and onChange; typing then Enter or comma adds a trimmed, deduplicated (case-insensitive) tag and clears the field; Backspace in an empty field removes the last chip; each chip has a labelled remove button (Remove react, for a chip named react); a maxTags prop blocks additions past the limit and shows a message with role status; pasting a comma-separated string adds multiple tags at once. Tests with @testing-library/user-event (its paste support) under vitest and jsdom covering every behavior above, including the dedupe case differing only in case. Iterate to a green npx vitest run.

content.thinking:
Now the component and tests.

Component requirements:
- controlled by value + onChange
- typing then Enter or comma adds a trimmed, deduplicated (case-insensitive) tag, clears field
- Backspace in empty field removes last chip
- each chip has labelled remove button ("Remove react")
- maxTags blocks additions past limit, shows message with role="status"
- paste comma-separated string adds multiple tags at once

Design: input with onKeyDown handler. For comma: intercept key "," before it's inserted (or use onChange to strip commas — but paste handling needs special care). Better approach: handle Enter/comma on keydown; for paste, use onPaste handler reading clipboardData text, splitting on commas. Also handle the case where user types comma — keydown preventDefault then add.

Edge cases: empty/whitespace tags skipped; dedupe case-insensitive against existing tags and within pasted batch; respect remaining capacity when pasting multiple (add up to available slots? or block entirely?). Spec says "maxTags blocks additions past the limit" — I'll add as many as fit and show status message when blocked. Actually "blocks additions past the limit and shows a message" — I'll add tags until limit reached, show status if some/all were blocked. Simpler and reasonable: filter new tags, add only those that fit, set message if any were dropped.

Status message should be announced; role="status" element always rendered (or when there is a message). Tests check getByRole("status"). If we only render when message exists, that works too. I'll render conditionally with role="status".

Message content: e.g., `Maximum of ${maxTags} tags reached.` Show when addition attempted while full. Keep message until next successful change or re-attempt. Simplest: set message whenever an addition is blocked; clear when tags are removed? Not required. I'll clear on removal so it doesn't linger misleadingly... spec just says shows a message. I'll keep simple: set on block, clear when a tag gets removed.

Input aria-label maybe "Add tag". Chips rendered as list items with remove buttons aria-label={`Remove ${tag}`}.
